<reason>CON won the live comparison: the mandate’s signal is too degraded to price work, yet still costly to workers via compression, gaming, and lost slow-build roles. PRO’s market-failure story and “blurry beats a locked drawer” frame were sharp, but never showed net benefit after conceding wide bands, manager-written captions, and redaction. CON’s outside-offer reply was the weaker limb; the noise-versus-leash split still decided the motion as written.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s Rebuttal 2 dissolving PRO’s “worthless yet expensive” trap: the same band can be noise to workers and a leash on managers because the two effects fall on different people.</best_rebuttal>
